A place for every child

Learning together, with no one left out.

A pooled education support fund and a proposed community canteen.

03

The need

The school reports providing free access for orphans and children from disadvantaged families. The number of beneficiaries is not confirmed. The community canteen is a planned project.

The proposed response

Build a pooled fund with confidential eligibility criteria. Prepare the canteen by funding both its setup and an agreed operating period.

Next steps

  1. 01

    Define support criteria and monitoring

  2. 02

    Approve canteen organisation and menus

  3. 03

    Secure funding for an operating period

Who will benefit?

The Beog-Zaadba school community. Scope and beneficiary numbers will be approved for each stage before launch.
